title: Wire oscore-fork provisioning into fuzz/interop/ec2-arm64/mutation workflows
description: Same defect class as mbzu: fuzz.yml, interop.yml, ec2-arm64.yml, mutation.yml also run cargo in the rust workspace but have no step materializing rust/oscore-fork, so [patch.crates-io] path dep fails at manifest load on fresh runners. Composite action .github/actions/oscore-fork already exists (created for ci.yml); add '- uses: ./.github/actions/oscore-fork' after checkout in each cargo job. Verify each workflow's working-directory/cd layout and fuzz-crate isolation before wiring.
close_reason: Landed: the composite action .github/actions/oscore-fork (created for ci.yml) is now wired after actions/checkout in every cargo-running job of fuzz.yml (rust-fuzz), interop.yml (frame-parser-interop, vector-compatibility, wire-format-python-to-rust), ec2-arm64.yml (rust-arm64), and mutation.yml (rust-mutants) — 6 insertion sites verified by a yaml-scan (every job with cargo now has fork=YES). Placement matches ci.yml (after checkout, before rust-toolchain and any cargo step, so [patch.crates-io] resolves at manifest load). Fuzz-crate isolation verified: the fuzz jobs run in rust/lichen-{schc,coap,link} subdirectories whose fuzz/ crates are separate workspaces — the fork materializes at rust/oscore-fork relative to the workspace root, which each cd target resolves correctly. YAML validated (all four parse). ci.yml was wired in the mbzu round (65085156aa).
